name: etenders_etenders_gov_za-mcp
description: eTenders Portal (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /api/OCDSReleases (PageNumber, PageSize, dateFrom, dateTo — 'dateFrom and dateTo fields are required'). The window is fixed to releases dated from the 1st of the current month (UTC) until now; the API has NO keyword, category or value filter, so query, category and min_budget are not sent — page through and filter on title/description/raw.tender.category/raw.tender.province yourself. OCDS releases: title = tender.title (often the bid number, e.g. NB124/2026), description = tender.description (the subject), buyer = buyer.name, budget_max = tender.value.amount (frequently 0 = not disclosed) in tender.value.currency, posted_at/deadline = tender.tenderPeriod start/end; raw.tender.status tells active from awarded/cancelled, raw.tender.documents link the bid documents and raw.tender.contactPerson the contact.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /api/OCDSReleases/release/{ocid} ('Get OCDS releases by ocid'), id = the ocid from search (e.g. ocds-9t57fa-171582).
